memphis_chain_verify.chain: Optional chain name; omit to verify all chains

memphis_grep.path: Directory or file to search in (default: ~/memphis)
memphis_grep.context: Lines of context around each match

memphis_git.args: Arguments to pass to the subcommand

memphis_brave_search.country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. PL

memphis_classify.state: The text to classify: a message, a document, a case file
memphis_classify.question: What to decide about it, in plain language
memphis_classify.criteria: Options as {key: description} pairs. The model reads the descriptions, so they carry the meaning. Needs at least 2 and at most 10 entries. Send a bare object like {"cards": "Reklamacje kart"} — not {"item": [...] }.
memphis_classify.type: choice (default), noul (yes/no), or score; score objects require ordinal keys 0..n-1
memphis_classify.threshold: Advisory confidence threshold from 0 to 1. Explicit policy overrides the service default; never grants action permissions.
memphis_classify.orders: 1 = one forward pass, faster but order-sensitive; 2 = averaged over both option orders, invariant to ordering

memphis_cron_script.name: Script name without the .sh suffix (required for add/remove/enable/disable)
